Garage door repair & care

Garage Door
Cable Repair

Professional assessment for loose cables and doors that lift unevenly.

What we do

A level door.
A clearer way forward.

Cables are part of the door’s lifting system. Loose or damaged cables call for an inspection of the complete assembly, rather than simply trying to run the door again.

Request a free estimate

  • Cable condition

    Report fraying, loose wire, or a cable that appears out of place.

  • Drums & brackets

    The attachment points and related lifting hardware are checked.

  • Door alignment

    Uneven movement helps identify the scope of the issue.

Good questions

A little clarity.
A lot of confidence.

What if the door is crooked?

Stop using it. Keep the opening clear and describe its position when you call.

Can I put the cable back myself?

Leave cables and tensioned lifting hardware to a trained garage door professional.

Do you offer same-day service?

Yes. Same-day appointments are available, including evenings and weekends. Call us to confirm the earliest available window for your location.

How much will my repair cost?

It depends on the door, the problem and the parts needed. We inspect first, explain your options, and give you a clear price before work begins.
